name: Coarseline
description: Three fat rules to a cell and no more, laid either across or down.

code.style: --rule: ( --ang: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@var(--ang), #000 0 18%, transparent 18% 36%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@var(--ang), #000 0 18%, transparent 18% 36%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
